dct_title_s: Outline map of a portion of the Department of the Missouri

dct_description_sm: Relief shown by spot heights.; The map shows the portions of the surveyed areas of Wyoming, Utah, Arizona, Texas, Arkanasas, Nebraska and Missouri. Colorado, New Mexico, Oklahoma (Indian Territory) and Kansas are shown in their entirety.
